item.title: Allergic rhinitis
item.description:
Night routine

  • wet wipe-down (not dry!) or shower. Change clothes.
  • run air purifier .5 hr before night sealing.
  • If you go to pee, in the middle of the night, wear a mask.
  • Target the nose. With corticosteroid sprays, saline rinses.
  • Severe cases - oral antihistamine (like fexofenadine or levocetirizine) taken a few hours before bed?

Combination drugs

Anti-histamine + Vasoconstrictor

  • Cetirizine-D (Zyrtec-D or Allegra-D) = ceterizine (histamine receptor blocker) + decongestant pseudoephedrine
  • Loratadine-D

Ayurvedic

  • pankajakastUri breathe easy
    • Maricham, Pippali, Viswam, Ela, Twag, Aswagandha, Amlika, Jeeraka, Vilwa, Vasaka, Hareetaki, Vibheetaki, Kasagni, Yojanavalli
  • Sitopaladi Churna with honey

Nasal sensitivity reduction

  • Steam inhalation with Ajwain (Trachyspermum ammi) or Pudina (Mentha spicata) or Eucalyptus oil once a day
  • Nasal oil application - medicated oil (Anu taila or Shadbindu Taila) or plain oil (Sesame or Coconut) or nasal application of cow’s ghee (Goghrita) once or twice in a day, especially before going out and after coming back to home

Nasal spray

Fluticasone nasal spray - a spray for each nostril once daily. Because it targets the underlying allergic inflammation rather than just temporarily constricting blood vessels, it takes a few days of continuous daily use to reach peak effectiveness. Using it only occasionally when you already feel stuffy will not give you the best results.

item.title: Dust mite part allergy
item.description:
Allergens

Dust mites themselves are 100-300 microns, and the allergy-causing fecal pellets are 10 to 40 microns.

Bedding

Cover

Medical reference: a woven cover with a pore size of 2 to 10 μm can prevent passage of house dust mites. Anything under 10 microns should block even the smallest dust particles.

Washing

Other low-cost steps that help more than the cover material

  • Wash all bedding weekly at 60C, dry in sun
  • Vacuum mattress with HEPA vacuum weekly
  • Keep indoor humidity <50% if possible, use cross-ventilation
  • No carpets, heavy curtains, or stuffed toys in bedroom
  • Wash pillow itself every 2-3 months

Terry + TPU

Terry + TPU waterproof protector with zipper
This is what most Flipkart / Meesho listings sell as “100% waterproof dust mite protector”. The TPU membrane inside has pores measured around ∼0.16 microns - so also 0 barrier but it is slightly breathable and doesn’t feel like plastic.
Price: Rs 600-1200 for single, Rs 800-1500 for queen on Flipkart/Meesho. Search “zippered mattress encasement dust mite proof”.

item.title: Inhalation device
item.description:
Environment friendliness

rotocaps (Dry Powder Inhalers / DPIs) are significantly more environmentally friendly than traditional pressurized metered-dose inhaler (pMDI) canisters and Synchrobreathe devices.

A single pMDI canister can have a carbon footprint equivalent to driving a car for up to 175–200 kilometers (around 15 to 30 kg of $\text{CO}_2$ equivalent per device).

The carbon footprint of a DPI/rotocap device is typically less than 1/20th (up to 95% lower) of a standard pMDI canister.
